IC2: Women with breast implants on the same side as the lesion
IC3: Women that underwent local radiation [OR] or chemotherapy within the last 12 months
IC4: Women with history of breast cancer [OR] or breast surgery in the same quadrant
IC5: Lesions in or close to scar tissue (< 1cm)
IC6: Skin lesions [OR] or lesions that have been biopsied previously
IC7: Lesion [AND] larger than 4 cm in the longest dimension
IC8: No lesion [AND] should be included when more than 50% of the lesion is further down than 4 cm beneath the skin level.
